item.title: Testing Magnitude vs llama.cpp: Is It Really 2x Faster?
item.description: Several days ago, I came across a claim from Magnitude stating that it’s up to 2x faster than llama.cpp, and—more interestingly for me—that it supports AMD GPUs as well. Naturally, I was skeptical. A 2x speedup over llama.cpp is a bold claim, especially on AMD hardware where the ROCm ecosystem can be hit-or-miss.
